notes.title: Dev Log and Release date
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Did you think we had forgotten you? 

Well no. We decided to question ourselves regarding the creation of the game, we took each person's feedback and we brainstormed to find a solution and avenues for improvement while retaining our strengths. 

For example, the user interface has been and will continue to be redesigned, with more inventory space, and much more interesting visual effects on the screen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/f1734eb2696c6e1d7aacec299b47f97ce6cdb8ca.png[/img]

For the environments, despite the positive feedback already obtained from the tests, we decided to make the universe even more alive with bases with advanced architecture and themes as you can see here in this building sneak peak ;)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/a5600bd4bd19ff2b308a3212d0586cfdc1207eb3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/faa89611cd6421c2db0f3c66fcf782fd82f47383.png[/img]

Plants and creatures are still being created with more interesting textures and gimmicks worth checking out.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/1cc3d21e4b5df29f62ea627812bb7d9afb187df3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/a8aea503122606a89bf783c8ac6e0baf4bcf7da8.png[/img]

We have decided to increase the number of passive mobs in the game in order to make it more lively!

And we have listened to your advice on tutorials and gamefeel elements.



So, when will the game be released?

Our main mistake was wanting to release a game with a good concept but poorly executed due to our impatience. Therefore, we are going to postpone the development of the game for a year. Not only to add new gameplay elements, refine what is already done, but also to be able to add achievements or lore in more depth.

This is why the game will be released in the 4th quarter of 2025 or in early 2026 depending on the game releases. 

We understand the issues, and will try to do our best for you and the game.

And happy new year 2025 to all those who follow us!

notes.title: Depth Diver Stream Dev Q&A

notes.title: Depth Diver Demo is Out Now!
notes.notes:
We did it.

We released the Depth Diver demo!!

Did you really think we disappeared because we gave up? ːsteamsadː
Well no, we worked hard for several months to be able to produce a demo of the game!

First of all, we left you following dev log 7 where we showed you a new UI, since then, it has evolved a lot, our UI has become more efficient, the use of objects has become more interesting and the systems have been optimized!

We have thus added one of the main mechanics of the game, [b]trash[/b]! One of our ideas was to show through our game the degradation of water and the extent to which [b]trash [/b]were ignored, that's why we had fun making various objects and waste that provide unique resources!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/6261778f094bb0c8116a9e91725c58a4c3ec45a6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/9455b6b7b339ffa2e7f0f2c58d08ea0cca15605e.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/4baf7574c8b77ce387454f04ad9f9d622b210a82.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/107e5b1e3e7920b660e9f21c707b6813b5366987.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/3ac1d87fe4311c03b30456c01ea5a1b1e33a87b6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/6f99f36ca14f9fa7b83b936112ef1aded0f4666d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/c166c3ec4fc611572b2c8713d42084521aa748c4.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/df9a0a649e059dca5f05265e4692a9d73a8259ac.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/820156314f9b6bbe863ef1ff048adc24a6015e2b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/2f9cf1abf5d59c6eae2f1ee2766066ed3d1a0536.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/f8a0927c53b44933b32ea71325b3392241e7d4b8.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/47e2044471e77bc24c754fdc5e9aa5321824a292.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/d97de3d6cc82d97ef6260a25621c2aa484b7fa86.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/98f6dc79bf423f587697334fdc919a29c1ea59c8.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/f5b3deb8d996963d8fa72760fbcca177d2d99e05.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/a7aad830925ff0270ecf1acd734e9e1ad594bf8e.png[/img][/url]

We have also created our own product brands by hand which are parodies of real things!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/0d7f887c8341a9513d2446edbb0d81e39acb73ee.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/0be2e6996cd67ddd8cb43077f04a78516a85ec19.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/b9205086fca8c44f4367b23a211b9ec607c65ffb.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/c70e832340016243c609347700c6592504b0e9f0.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/8ba5dfebfde7cd4dace791f53ff1fbb4f8f0ba08.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/0ed1810f377781d69e25ef38fcb9ef053bf8fa16.png[/img][/url]

Then, one of our main goals was to make a game that would be fun to explore, so we spent time making plants, biomes and unique interactions that would make the environment beautiful!
We have thus created plants, unique harmless [b]creatures [/b]that I think you will enjoy discovering!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/0e49606f86ee150530fbf8e4694ec0c353f53805.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/c987344328f0dbbbdc686f2ba247a3191d94efbe.png[/img]

With this, the buildings in the game were a very important point, we wanted buildings that tell a story, every detail is precise, makes us question what happened here, and the traps and secrets that lie ahead. For me, this is a big strong point of the game, we really wanted to create a separate and unique bubble that allows you to enjoy some calm time! And we have, I think, succeeded.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/381f9e723a7e3b26e2bda4e9720b535070e8943a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/e70f54dae1be32b5afd6eec36858bceff6aa5ef8.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/5ea0f8f8a9f4f5a317ef20f848683ba7254216e4.png[/img]

One of the most important points of the game was the hallucinations! We absolutely wanted to show a form of narcosis and intoxication of the depths taken to the extreme, so we took pleasure in creating ourselves a very large quantity of sound effects for the game, more or less frightening! (We are waiting for your feedback on these)
But on top of that, we have integrated visual hallucinations, some are very violent while others, more subtle, give the impression of a bug or madness on the part of the player when he realizes it!
There are currently 9 of them, and I'll let you tell us which ones!
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/72580201a3aa6b6ebc1d5a591188e51e920ade58.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/d51a2d62a29204624b9b8c74d3db9db6d950ec4c.png[/img][/url]

Another point of the game was the [b]creatures[/b], we wanted in this demo that the 3 [b]creatures [/b]that time allowed us to make were different and unique of their kind, and we are satisfied with the result, (although, they will soon receive improvements absolutely terrifying!)
One of them I hope will give you [b]nightmares[/b]. It is huge, visible, slow. But with the particularity of always attacking discreetly. If she's too close, don't try to run away, she's seen you. [b]SHE WILL HAVE YOU,
SHE WILL END YOUR GAMES!!!!![/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/397c8da6a8658dacd0b0a116c449fa27e54bfe76.png[/img]

Apart from that, we have added small creatures, which will serve as a taster for more pacifist creatures which make the environment alive!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45030441/eb72e63f895d0c956adb6080c77eff47b514435b.png[/img]

Regarding balancing, the game may seem difficult at first, however, don't give up, the ocean of [b]Gornak [/b]only belongs to those who know how to tame it, but also know it. Take advantage of the environment, absorb it rather than seeing it as an enemy, and you will succeed!

The demo takes around 5/6 hours to complete and 10 hours minimum to be 100% complete

To conclude, I only have one piece of advice to give you! Take this game as it is, welcome it, and it will welcome you!
[previewyoutube=dIoI8AlfD9E;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]










Oh and!
Don't forget to..
[b]Fear the depth...[/b]

notes.title: Before any accusation of plagiarism.
notes.notes:
A few days ago, one of the most horrible situations that could happen to us as a video game development team happened.

The recently released Murky Diver game is a game inspired by lethal company in 4-player cooperation in which you have to erase traces of corpses in underwater installations.

The fact is that as the developers of Depth Diver, in the process of shaping for months a game, we will have certain design similarities elements from Murky Diver which were not intended to be of course.

In themselves the two games are different. One consists of a unique mission, is indoors, and has very different creatures, and Depth Diver is a game where several missions on behalf of the Metallurgical Union must be accomplished, with many biologically possible creatures.

A Quest in game, however, has the particularity of being a quest where you have to bring back pieces of submarine and human bodies to bear witness to the failure of a mission on the part of other divers.
This quest is very similar to the mission in the Murky Diver game.

And this is why we are already seeing accusations of plagiarism coming. It is important to clarify that:

We are in NO WAY plagiarizing Murky Diver, and it is in no way intended that the two games are similar. 

We made this game based on our first experience of subnautica, while doing something multiplayer like Phasmophobia.

It was important for us to clarify this thing in order to prepare for the release of Depth Diver as best as possible and avoid problems at that time.

This post is also not an attack on the developers whom we respect very much.

Yours sincerely,
and remember to..
[b]Fear the Depth[/b]
